title: Self-Evolving Coding Rules for AI Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.00650v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The performance of AI coding agents is highly dependent on their underlying coding rules. However, existing coding rules are typically hand-crafted and fixed, making the process labor-intensive and often suboptimal. In this work, we propose RuleEvolve, a self-evolving framework for coding rules. RuleEvolve maintains a pool of candidate coding rules and iteratively improves them. In each iteration, it employs an LLM-powered mutator module to generate variants from existing candidates, and then uses a judge module to evaluate these variants and update the pool with the best-performing ones. Extensive evaluations across two coding-agent frameworks, four backbone LLMs, and three benchmarks demonstrate that RuleEvolve outperforms both manual engineering and existing prompt optimization baselines in terms of functional correctness of the generated code, code length, and/or generation cost (e.g., tokens used).

translated_title: 面向AI编程代理的自演化编程规则
translated_abstract: AI编程代理的性能在很大程度上取决于其底层的编程规则。然而，现有的编程规则通常是手工编写且固定不变的，这使得该过程非常耗费人力，且往往难以达到最优效果。在这项工作中，我们提出了RuleEvolve，一个编程规则的自演化框架。RuleEvolve维护一个候选编程规则池并进行迭代改进。在每次迭代中，它使用由大语言模型驱动的变异器模块从现有候选规则生成变体，然后使用评判模块对这些变体进行评估，并将表现最佳的规则更新到规则池中。在两个编程代理框架、四个骨干大语言模型和三个基准测试上的广泛评估表明，RuleEvolve在生成代码的功能正确性、代码长度和/或生成成本（例如所使用的token数量）方面均优于人工工程和现有的提示词优化基线方法。
tldr: 提出了RuleEvolve自演化框架，利用LLM驱动的变异器和评判模块迭代改进编程规则，在代码功能正确性、长度和生成成本上超越人工规则工程与现有提示优化基线。
en_tdlr: RuleEvolve is a self-evolving framework that iteratively improves coding rules for AI coding agents via an LLM-powered mutator and judge module, outperforming manual rule engineering and prompt optimization baselines in code correctness, length, and generation cost.
